attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: food_label_ai_scanning
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "app_user"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_receive_image
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/camera/capture"
    output: raw_image

  - id: step_validate_image
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_image
      schema: image_format_and_size_schema
    output: validated_image

  - id: step_send_to_vision_api
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: validated_image
      url: "https://ai-vision.example.com/extract-nutrition"
      method: "POST"
    output: raw_ai_response

  - id: step_extract_nutrition
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: raw_ai_response
      fields:
        - "calories"
        - "protein"
        - "carbohydrates"
        - "fat"
        - "serving_size"
    output: extracted_nutrition

  - id: step_validate_nutrition
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: extracted_nutrition
      schema: plausible_nutrition_schema
      rules:
        max_calories_per_serving: 2000
    output: validated_nutrition

  - id: step_check_plausibility
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "validated_nutrition.validation_warnings is not empty"
    output: plausibility_result

  - id: step_route_flagged
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "plausibility_result == true"
      true_step: step_flag_for_review
      false_step: step_format_form

  - id: step_flag_for_review
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: validated_nutrition
      action: "flagged_implausible_nutrition_values"
      severity: "warning"
    output: flag_log_result

  - id: step_format_form
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: validated_nutrition
      template: "food_entry_prefilled_form"
      format: "json"
    output: prefilled_form

  - id: step_notify_user_confirmation
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: prefilled_form
      message: "Please review and confirm the extracted nutritional data before saving."
      channel: "in_app"
    output: user_notification_result

  - id: step_wait_user_confirm
    op: wait_for_condition
    params:
      condition: "user_confirmation_received == true"
      timeout_seconds: 300
    output: user_confirmation

  - id: step_route_confirmed
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "user_confirmation.confirmed == true"
      true_step: step_write_food_log
      false_step: step_terminate_cancelled

  - id: step_write_food_log
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: prefilled_form
      table: "food_log_entries"
    output: write_result

  - id: step_audit_log_entry
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: prefilled_form
      action: "food_log_entry_created_via_ai_scan"
    output: audit_result

  - id: step_terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
      message: "Food log entry successfully created from label scan."

  - id: step_terminate_cancelled
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "cancelled"
      message: "User declined the extracted nutritional data."
